msg: Created state.json with 7 tasks: spike-1 (BPI 2014 exploration), feat-1 (setup), feat-2 (adapter), feat-3 (ingest+normalize), feat-4 (completeness+historical), feat-5 (schedule+conditional), feat-6 (synthesis+runner). Real-first strategy with graceful degradation.
